svg.text: 7 WONDERS DUEL: BOARD SETUP & AGE LAYOUTS
Conflict Track, Age I / II / III Card Structures, Wonder Slots & Symbol Legend
5 random Progress Tokens face-up; 3 returned to box
Pawn starts on 0 • Entering Capital = Military Supremacy Win • Crossing Token = Opponent loses 2 or 5 coins once
CARD STRUCTURES BY AGE (20 Cards/Age; Remove 3 Unseen)
PLAYER STARTING KIT, WONDER DRAFT & WONDER CARD ANATOMY
• Draft Pool 1 (4 Wonders): P1 picks 1 → P2 picks 2 → P1 gets 1.
Each player starts with 4 unbuilt Wonders beside their city,
but only 7 Wonders TOTAL can be built across both players.
Once the 7th is constructed, the 8th is removed from play.
How Wonder Cards Work (Each Wonder Is Unique)

g.text: Red: Military (1–3 Shields advance Conflict Pawn)
Purple (Age III): Guilds (Coins now + end-game VP)
• White Chain Icon (Top-Left / Right): If you own the
prerequisite building, construct this card for FREE.
• Coin Icon (1 / 2 / 3): Gain coins from bank immediately.
• Laurel Wreath (Number): Victory Points at end of Age III.
• Crossed Swords (Shield): Move Conflict Pawn +1 space.
• ↻ Circular Arrow (Wonder): Play an immediate extra turn.
• Card + Slash / Discard Icon: Destroy opponent's Brown/Gray
card, or build 1 card free from the discard pile.
• Green Progress Tokens: Permanent passive buff or VP

svg.text: Card Selection, 3 Action Choices, Chaining/Trading & Victory Checks
Take 1 Accessible Face-Up Card from the Current Structure
Choose any face-up card that is NOT overlapped by any card in a lower row.
You MUST use this card to execute one of the three actions in Step 2 below.
STEP 2: RESOLVE ONE OF THREE ACTIONS WITH THE CHOSEN CARD
Place card face-up in your city
Build for FREE if you own the
Tactical use: Bury a card your
Trigger its unique effect right away.
Check Instant Supremacy Victory & Science Pairs
• Each Shield moves Conflict Pawn +1 space.
• Crossing a Military Token line: opponent
claim 1 face-up Progress Token from board.
• Law Progress Token grants a 7th symbol.
Uncover Newly Freed Cards & Check End of Age
1. Flip face-up any face-down cards that are no longer overlapped.
2. If cards remain → Opponent takes next turn (unless Wonder gave Extra Turn ↻).
3. If structure is empty → Set up Age II (Inverted) or Age III (Diamond + 3 Guilds).
• Next Age Start Player: Weaker military (pawn closer to their capital) chooses who starts.
• Tie on 0: The player who took the LAST card of the previous Age chooses start player.
END OF AGE III: CIVILIAN VICTORY SCORING (If No Supremacy Win)
Sum Victory Points (VP) across all 8 scoring categories:
5. Built Wonders 6. Progress Tokens 7. Military Track (2 / 5 / 10 VP) 8. Treasury (1 VP / 3 Coins)
Highest Total VP Wins • Tie-Breaker: Most VP from Blue (Civilian) cards (if still tied, shared victory).
